$comment: Known swimstyle id series (inclusive), from config/template_pool.lxf (5xx) and config/template_beach.lxf (6xx). LXF imports in both apps flag any style id outside these ranges (stale or foreign template) and refuse a meet structure mixing pool and beach ids. Consumed by meet-app (src/main/swimstyleRanges.ts) and team-app (backend/app/swimstyle_check.py). Widen a range here when a template gains a new style.
